chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Tatari, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abd Allah ibn Muskan, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام as the final authority in the chain
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: meaning that the text is the same as the preceding hadith

ai.seo_question: What does Hadith 3 in the chapter on praying toward other than the qiblah in al-Istibsar narrate?
ai.summary: This report provides only the sanad/isnad and indicates that the Imam's statement is the same as a previous hadith. It belongs to the chapter concerning one who prayed toward other than the qiblah and then realized that afterward, whether before the expiry of the time or after it.
